propositions: The inline last_get_pass field must be removed from bindings.json after a successful new-writer save operation, with the chronological maximum promoted to get_rotation.json.
Sidecar persistence must complete before inline field scrubbing; if sidecar write fails, the primary binding save succeeds and retains the inline floor for convergence on retry.
A crash or failure after sidecar replace but before bindings replace must not lose the chronological maximum, which must already be durable in the sidecar.
Mixed old-writer and new-writer sequences must converge by migrating any later legacy inline stamp into get_rotation.json before scrubbing the binding payload.
All acceptance criteria must be code-verifiable: reload order exactness, anti-starvation bounds, and packed repository cost at or below A2-1 baseline.
Rollout closure requires descendant reconcile-bridge.yml evidence, explicit host probe refresh from an A2-1+ ancestor commit, and verification that no older writer process remains.
